headline: Argentine Stocks and Bonds Plunge as Country Risk Exceeds 850 Points
summary: Argentine sovereign risk surpassed 850 points as local stocks fell up to 8% in Wall Street trading, wholesale the US dollar weakened, and the central bank purchased USD 9 million.
why: Argentina's country risk premium and foreign exchange reserves are critical indicators for emerging market investors tracking macroeconomic stabilization efforts.

impacts.name: MERVAL
impacts.why: Spike in country risk and sell-off in Wall Street listings weigh directly on Argentine equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Worsening sovereign risk metrics and external market pressures caused a sharp decline in Argentine equities and debt instruments.
